commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore: upgrade postgres and harden test-endpoints script

- bump postgres image from 18.0 to 18.3
- add restart: unless-stopped policy to postgres service
- fix healthcheck to use exec form and target correct database
- add set -euo pipefail for strict error handling
- support configurable BASE_URL env var instead of hardcoded localhost
- add preflight connectivity check before running tests
- validate all token acquisition steps and fail fast on error
- clean up existing user2 before signup to allow idempotent reruns
- quote all variable expansions to prevent word splitting

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
test(security): add unit and integration tests for cors, jwt filter, and order controller

- wire cors via Customizer.withDefaults() so the security filter chain honours CorsConfig
- add CorsConfigTest covering allowed/disallowed origins, preflight, and simple requests
- add CorsConfigMultipleOriginsTest verifying multiple allowed origins are each accepted
- add TokenAuthenticationFilterTest covering valid token, expired/invalid token, missing
  header, malformed prefix, and userDetailsService exception edge cases
- add OrderControllerTest case for 404 when user is deleted between auth and order creation

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
refactor(security): use explicit UTF-8 encoding and safer token parsing

- replace String.getBytes() with getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8) for deterministic signing key derivation
- replace String.replace() with substring() to strip token prefix without regex semantics

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore: upgrade Spring Boot to 4.0.5 and apply minor cleanups

- Bump spring-boot-starter-parent from 4.0.3 → 4.0.5
- Add @Column(nullable = false) constraints to User and Order entities
- Guard createdAt assignment in @PrePersist to prevent overwrite on update
- Replace String.format() with String.formatted() throughout
- Inject ObjectMapper via @Autowired in controller tests instead of constructing manually
- Switch ObjectMapper import to tools.jackson.databind in tests
- Remove redundant @Repository from UserRepository and OrderRepository
- Move TokenProvider constants to top of class; unbox jwtExpirationMinutes to long
- Use countUsers() instead of getUsers().isEmpty() in DatabaseInitializer
- Make DatabaseInitializer.getUsers() static
- Add jq preflight check to test-endpoints.sh
- Update brace-expansion to 1.1.13 and picomatch to 4.0.4 in lockfile
- Clarify DatabaseInitializer seeding behaviour and test file naming in AGENTS.md

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
refactor(security): introduce `Role` enum to replace string role constants

- add `Role` enum with `ADMIN` and `USER` values in the security package
- update `User` entity to use `Role` field with `@Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)`
- remove `ADMIN`/`USER` string constants from `SecurityConfig`
- update all role references across controllers, services, and initializer
- use `role.name()` when a string authority is required by spring security
- align `UserDto` record and `UserRepository` query to use `Role` type
- update all tests to construct users and authorities with `Role` enum

Add ESLint flat config with browser globals, test file overrides,

`"type": "module"` in package.json, remove obsolete vite esbuild
loader workaround, and fix two lint violations in source files.

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
feat(user): prevent self-deletion and last-admin deletion

Add guards to the delete-user endpoint that reject requests when the
authenticated user tries to delete their own account or when deleting
the only remaining admin. Introduce UserDeletionNotAllowedException,
a countByRole repository query, and a countAdmins service method to
support these checks. Cover the new cases with controller and service
unit tests.
